nodes.summary: A modal formula $\varphi$ is a theorem of K iff it passes the following finite check: for every nonempty set $U$ of subsets of the set $\mathrm{sub}(\varphi)$ of subformulas of $\varphi$, every relation $R \subseteq U \times U$ and every $s \in U$, $\varphi$ evaluates to true at $s$ in the finite Kripke model on $U$ with relation $R$ in which an atom $p$ is true at $s$ iff $p \in s$.
nodes.title: Finite-check criterion for K-theorems

nodes.summary: A modal formula $\varphi$ is a theorem of K iff for every nonempty set $U$ of subsets of the set $\mathrm{sub}(\varphi)$ of subformulas of $\varphi$ and every finite set $R$ of pairs of finite sets of formulas, $\varphi$ holds at every world of the Kripke model whose worlds are the elements of $U$, in which $s$ sees $t$ iff $(s, t) \in R$, and in which an atom $p$ is true at $s$ iff $p \in s$.
nodes.title: K-theorems via finite models on sets of subformulas

nodes.summary: A modal formula $\varphi$ is a theorem of S4 if and only if, for every nonempty set $U$ of subsets of $\mathrm{sub}(\varphi)$, the set of subformulas of $\varphi$, and every relation $R \subseteq U \times U$ that is reflexive and transitive on $U$, the formula $\varphi$ is true at every world $s \in U$ of the finite model with worlds $U$, accessibility relation $R$, and each atom true at $s$ exactly when it belongs…
nodes.title: S4-provability via finite reflexive transitive models

nodes.summary: A modal formula $\varphi$ is a theorem of S5 if and only if, for every nonempty set $U$ of subsets of $\mathrm{sub}(\varphi)$, the set of subformulas of $\varphi$, and every relation $R \subseteq U \times U$ that is reflexive, symmetric and transitive on $U$, the formula $\varphi$ is true at every world $s \in U$ of the finite model with worlds $U$, accessibility relation $R$, and each atom true at $s$ exactly when…
nodes.title: S5-provability via finite equivalence models

nodes.summary: A modal formula $\varphi$ is a theorem of T if and only if, for every nonempty set $U$ of subsets of $\mathrm{sub}(\varphi)$, the set of subformulas of $\varphi$, and every relation $R \subseteq U \times U$ that is reflexive on $U$, the formula $\varphi$ is true at every world $s \in U$ of the finite model with worlds $U$, accessibility relation $R$, and each atom true at $s$ exactly when it belongs to $s$.
nodes.title: T-provability via finite reflexive models

nodes.summary: Given a finite set $U$ of finite sets of formulas, a finite set $R$ of pairs of such sets and a finite set $s$ of formulas, the Boolean value of a formula at $s$ is defined by recursion on the formula: an atom $p$ is true iff $p \in s$; $\bot$ is false; $\varphi \to \psi$ is true iff $\varphi$ is false or $\psi$ is true at $s$; and $\Box\varphi$ is true iff $\varphi$ is true at every $t \in U$ with $(s, t) \in R$.
nodes.title: Boolean evaluation in a finite model

nodes.summary: If a modal formula $\varphi$ is not a theorem of S4, then there is a Kripke model with finitely many worlds, at most $2^{|\mathrm{sub}(\varphi)|}$ of them, where $\mathrm{sub}(\varphi)$ is the set of subformulas of $\varphi$, whose accessibility relation is reflexive and transitive and in which $\varphi$ is false at some world.
nodes.title: Finite model property of S4

nodes.summary: If a modal formula $\varphi$ is not a theorem of S5, then there is a Kripke model with finitely many worlds, at most $2^{|\mathrm{sub}(\varphi)|}$ of them, where $\mathrm{sub}(\varphi)$ is the set of subformulas of $\varphi$, whose accessibility relation is an equivalence relation and in which $\varphi$ is false at some world.
nodes.title: Finite model property of S5

nodes.summary: If a modal formula $\varphi$ is not a theorem of T, then there is a Kripke model with finitely many worlds, at most $2^{|\mathrm{sub}(\varphi)|}$ of them, where $\mathrm{sub}(\varphi)$ is the set of subformulas of $\varphi$, whose accessibility relation is reflexive and in which $\varphi$ is false at some world.
nodes.title: Finite model property of T

nodes.summary: A formula that is not a K-theorem fails in a Kripke model with at most `2 ^ |sub φ|` worlds.
nodes.title: Finite model property of K

nodes.summary: A modal formula that is not a theorem of K fails at some world of some Kripke model.
nodes.title: Completeness of K, countermodel form

nodes.summary: Let $M$ be a Kripke model and $\varphi$ a modal formula, and call the set of subformulas of $\varphi$ satisfied at a world $w$ of $M$ the type of $w$. Every world $s$ of the filtration of $M$ through the subformulas of $\varphi$, that is, every element of the finite set of types occurring in $M$, is the type of some world of $M$.
nodes.title: Filtration worlds are realized types

nodes.summary: Let $M$ be a Kripke model and $\varphi$ a modal formula, and call the set of subformulas of $\varphi$ satisfied at a world $w$ of $M$ the type of $w$. The smallest filtration relation is the finite set of pairs $(s, t)$ of types such that there are worlds $w$ and $w'$ of $M$ of types $s$ and $t$ with $w'$ accessible from $w$.
nodes.title: Smallest filtration relation

nodes.summary: Let $M$ be a Kripke model and $\varphi$ a modal formula. The worlds of the filtration of $M$ through the subformulas of $\varphi$ form the finite set of types occurring in $M$: the subsets $s$ of the set $\mathrm{sub}(\varphi)$ of subformulas of $\varphi$ such that $s$ is the set of subformulas of $\varphi$ satisfied at some world of $M$.
nodes.title: Worlds of the filtration

nodes.summary: Let $M$ be a Kripke model and $\varphi$ a modal formula, and call the set of subformulas of $\varphi$ satisfied at a world $w$ of $M$ the type of $w$. The filtration of $M$ through the subformulas of $\varphi$ is the Kripke model whose worlds are the types occurring in $M$, in which a type $s$ sees a type $t$ iff some world of type $s$ sees some world of type $t$ in $M$, and in which an atom $p$ is true at $s$ iff…
nodes.title: Smallest filtration of a Kripke model

nodes.summary: Let $U$ be a nonempty finite set of finite sets of formulas and $R$ a finite set of pairs of finite sets of formulas. The Kripke model on $U$ with relation $R$ has the elements of $U$ as worlds, a world $s$ sees a world $t$ iff $(s, t) \in R$, and an atom $p$ is true at $s$ iff $p \in s$.
nodes.title: Finite Kripke model on sets of formulas

nodes.summary: Let $M$ be a Kripke model whose accessibility relation is reflexive, let $\varphi$ be a modal formula, and let $R$ be a filtration of $M$ through the subformulas of $\varphi$. Then $(s, s) \in R$ for every set $s$ that is the set of subformulas of $\varphi$ true at some world of $M$.
nodes.title: Filtrations of reflexive models are reflexive

nodes.summary: Let $U$ be a finite set of finite sets of modal formulas and $R$ a finite set of pairs of such sets. Then $R$ is reflexive on $U$ when $(s, s) \in R$ for every $s \in U$.
nodes.title: Reflexivity on a finite set of worlds

nodes.summary: Let $U$ be a finite set of finite sets of modal formulas and $R$ a finite set of pairs of such sets. Then $R$ is symmetric on $U$ when $(t, s) \in R$ for all $s, t \in U$ with $(s, t) \in R$.
nodes.title: Symmetry on a finite set of worlds

nodes.summary: Let $U$ be a finite set of finite sets of modal formulas and $R$ a finite set of pairs of such sets. Then $R$ is transitive on $U$ when $(s, r) \in R$ for all $s, t, r \in U$ with $(s, t) \in R$ and $(t, r) \in R$.
nodes.title: Transitivity on a finite set of worlds

nodes.summary: Let $C$ be a condition on pairs $(U, R)$ of a finite set $U$ of sets of formulas and a finite relation $R$ on such sets, and let $\varphi$ be a formula that passes the finite check for $C$. Let $M$ be a Kripke model, let $U_\varphi$ be the set of types of worlds of $M$ (the sets of subformulas of $\varphi$ satisfied at a world), and let $R \subseteq U_\varphi \times U_\varphi$ satisfy $C(U_\varphi, R)$. Then…
nodes.title: The finite check covers the filtration worlds

nodes.summary: Given a condition $C$ on pairs $(U, R)$ of a finite set $U$ of sets of formulas and a finite set $R$ of pairs of such sets, a formula $\varphi$ passes the finite check for $C$ when, for every nonempty set $U$ of subsets of the subformulas of $\varphi$ and every relation $R \subseteq U \times U$ with $C(U, R)$, $\varphi$ holds at every $s \in U$ in the Kripke model with worlds $U$, accessibility relation $R$, and an…
nodes.title: Finite validity check for a frame condition

nodes.summary: A modal formula $\varphi$ passes the finite check when, for every nonempty set $U$ of subsets of the set $\mathrm{sub}(\varphi)$ of subformulas of $\varphi$, every relation $R \subseteq U \times U$ and every $s \in U$, the formula $\varphi$ is true at $s$ in the Kripke model with set of worlds $U$, accessibility relation $R$, and an atom $p$ true at a world $t$ iff $p \in t$; truth is computed by recursion on…
nodes.title: Finite validity check for K

nodes.summary: Let $M$ be a Kripke model and $\varphi$ a modal formula, and call the set of subformulas of $\varphi$ true at a world $w$ the type of $w$. The relation that relates two types when some worlds of those types are related in $M$ is a filtration of $M$ through the set of subformulas of $\varphi$.
nodes.title: The smallest filtration is a filtration

nodes.summary: For every Kripke model $M$ with a transitive accessibility relation and every formula $\varphi$, the Lemmon relation of $M$ and $\varphi$ is a filtration of $M$ through the subformulas of $\varphi$.
nodes.title: The Lemmon relation is a filtration of a transitive model

nodes.summary: For every Kripke model $M$ whose accessibility relation is an equivalence relation and every formula $\varphi$, the S5 relation of $M$ and $\varphi$ is a filtration of $M$ through the subformulas of $\varphi$.
nodes.title: The S5 relation is a filtration of an equivalence model

nodes.summary: Let $M$ be a Kripke model, $\varphi$ a modal formula, $\Sigma$ the set of subformulas of $\varphi$, and for a world $w$ let $[w]$, the type of $w$, be the set of formulas of $\Sigma$ true at $w$ in $M$. A relation $R$ on finite sets of formulas is a filtration of $M$ through $\Sigma$ when (min) for all worlds $w, v$ related in $M$, the pair $([w], [v])$ is in $R$, and (max) for all worlds $w, v$ with…
nodes.title: Filtration relations

nodes.summary: Let $M$ be a Kripke model and $\varphi$ a formula, and let $U_\varphi$ be the set of types of worlds of $M$ (the sets of subformulas of $\varphi$ satisfied at a world). The Lemmon relation is the relation $R$ on $U_\varphi$ such that $s \mathrel{R} t$ iff for every formula $\psi$ with $\Box\psi$ a subformula of $\varphi$, $\Box\psi \in s$ implies $\Box\psi \in t$ and $\psi \in t$.
nodes.title: Lemmon filtration relation

nodes.summary: Let $M$ be a Kripke model, $\varphi$ a formula and $R$ a filtration of $M$ through the subformulas of $\varphi$. If $\varphi$ fails at some world of $M$, then $\varphi$ is not valid in the finite model whose worlds are the types of worlds of $M$ (the sets of subformulas of $\varphi$ satisfied at a world), with relation $R$ and an atom true at a type iff it belongs to it.
nodes.title: A filtration refutes what the model refutes

nodes.summary: Let $M$ be a Kripke model and $\varphi$ a formula, and let $U_\varphi$ be the set of types of worlds of $M$ (the sets of subformulas of $\varphi$ satisfied at a world). The S5 relation is the relation $R$ on $U_\varphi$ such that $s \mathrel{R} t$ iff for every formula $\psi$ with $\Box\psi$ a subformula of $\varphi$, $\Box\psi \in s$ iff $\Box\psi \in t$.
nodes.title: S5 filtration relation

nodes.summary: Let $M$ be a Kripke model, $\varphi$ a modal formula, and for a world $w$ let $[w]$, the type of $w$, be the set of subformulas of $\varphi$ true at $w$ in $M$. For every subformula $\psi$ of $\varphi$ and every world $w$ of $M$, $\psi$ holds at $[w]$ in the smallest filtration of $M$ through the subformulas of $\varphi$ iff $\psi$ holds at $w$ in $M$.
nodes.title: Filtration lemma for the smallest filtration

nodes.summary: Let $M$ be a Kripke model, $\varphi$ a modal formula, and for a world $w$ let $[w]$, the type of $w$, be the set of subformulas of $\varphi$ true at $w$ in $M$. Let $R$ be a filtration of $M$ through the subformulas of $\varphi$, and let $M^R$ be the Kripke model whose worlds are the types of the worlds of $M$, with accessibility relation $R$ and an atom true at a type iff the type contains it. Then for every…
nodes.title: Filtration lemma

nodes.summary: Let $M$ be a Kripke model and $\varphi$ a modal formula, and call the set of subformulas of $\varphi$ true at a world $w$ of $M$ the type of $w$. If two worlds $w$ and $v$ of $M$ have the same type, then every subformula $\psi$ of $\varphi$ holds at $w$ iff it holds at $v$.
nodes.title: Worlds of the same type agree on subformulas

nodes.summary: If $\psi$ is a subformula of a modal formula $\varphi$, then every subformula of $\psi$ is a subformula of $\varphi$.
nodes.title: The subformula relation is transitive

nodes.summary: Given a Kripke model $M$ and a modal formula $\varphi$, the type (or $\Sigma$-type, for $\Sigma$ the set of subformulas of $\varphi$) of a world $w$ of $M$ is the finite set of subformulas of $\varphi$ that hold at $w$ in $M$.
nodes.title: Type of a world

nodes.summary: The finite set $\mathrm{sub}(\varphi)$ of subformulas of a modal formula $\varphi$, including $\varphi$ itself, is defined by recursion: $\mathrm{sub}(p) = \{p\}$ for an atom $p$, $\mathrm{sub}(\bot) = \{\bot\}$, $\mathrm{sub}(\varphi \to \psi) = \{\varphi \to \psi\} \cup \mathrm{sub}(\varphi) \cup \mathrm{sub}(\psi)$, and $\mathrm{sub}(\Box\varphi) = \{\Box\varphi\} \cup \mathrm{sub}(\varphi)$.
nodes.title: Subformulas

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
